title: The expanding horizon of neurotechnology: Is multimodal neuromodulation the future?
content:
by Silvestro Micera, Guglielmo Foffani

The clinical applications of neurotechnology are rapidly expanding, and the combination of different approaches could be more effective and precise to treat brain disorders. This Perspective discusses the potential and challenges of “multimodal neuromodulation,” which combines modalities such as electrical, magnetic, and ultrasound stimulation.
